metadata.model_engine: Google Flights Real-Time Ingestion + Gemini Gotcha Auditor + 90-Day Percentile Radar

flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via DEN • Airbus A320neo)
flights.notes: Cheapest flight ($429). Nonstop direct available at $929.

audit.baggage_status: $45+ Carry-on Fee (Frontier UltraLowCost unbundled overhead & checked luggage)
gotchas: Strict unbundled baggage fees quickly erode base fare savings
High winter weather disruption risk at Denver (DEN) hub during peak holiday travel
Tight 30-minute layover in DEN leaves zero margin for error
Operated on mainline Airbus A320neo, but ULCC seat pitch and recline are restricted
positive_highlights: Priced at the 31.1th historical percentile for Christmas peak demand
Saves roughly $33 compared to the seasonal route median
Convenient midday departure time avoiding early morning rush
audit.rationale: At the 31st percentile for Christmas week, $429 is a decent baseline for holiday travel, but the 30-minute DEN connection and Frontier's steep bag fees require careful calculation. Factor in baggage costs and winter weather vulnerability before locking in this fare.

flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via HOU • Boeing 737MAX 8 Passenger)

audit.baggage_status: 2 Bags Free (Southwest standard policy includes two complimentary checked bags and a free carry-on)
gotchas: Extremely high historical price point sitting at the 97.8th percentile

1-stop routing via HOU with a tight 30-minute layover
positive_highlights: Includes Southwest's industry-leading two free checked bags
Operates on a modern Boeing 737MAX 8 aircraft
Favorable summer hiking travel window to Salt Lake City
audit.rationale: At the 97.8th percentile, this $597 fare is drastically overpriced for this corridor despite the perk of free checked bags. You should wait and monitor for price drops or alternative routings before locking in your Wasatch hiking trip.

flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via BWI • Airbus A321neo)
flights.notes: Cheapest flight ($475). Nonstop direct available at $571.

gotchas: 97.8th percentile historical pricing represents severe overpayment
Absurd 1-stop routing via BWI for a short 225-mile ATL-CLT corridor
Ultrafast 30-minute connection at BWI creates high risk of baggage or passenger misconnection
Unbundled carrier extras will push total trip cost well past $550
positive_highlights: Operated by modern Airbus A321neo equipment
audit.rationale: At the 97.8th percentile, this $475 price tag is a massive rip-off for a short regional hop that should cost under $200. Furthermore, routing through BWI for an ATL-CLT flight introduces needless delay and misconnection risks on an ultra-low-cost carrier.

flights.notes: American direct transcon vs Delta 1-stop via ATL. Ski bags count as standard checked luggage.

gotchas: 97.8th percentile historical pricing indicates massive holiday price inflation
Grueling 2-stop routing via BNA with a lengthy 4.1-hour layover
Total travel time exceeds 7 hours for a domestic transcon ski trip
Winter weather vulnerabilities across multiple connection points during Christmas week

flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via DFW • Airbus A320neo)
flights.notes: Cheapest flight ($187). Nonstop direct available at $198.

gotchas: Unbundled baggage fees for overhead carry-on and checked bags
Extremely tight 30-minute connection at DFW during peak winter travel
Frontier Airlines zero flexibility for delays and lack of interline agreements
positive_highlights: Exceptional price sitting at the 4.4th historical percentile for MLK weekend
Saves an estimated $51.0 against the historical median fare
Favorable afternoon departure and evening arrival schedule
audit.rationale: At the 4.4th historical percentile for Martin Luther King weekend, this $187 fare represents an absolute market bottom that will inevitably rise. You must act immediately, but keep in mind the 30-minute DFW layover and add the cost of carry-on bags into your final budget calculation.

flights.notes: Nonstop 1 hour 20 min flight. Very high Spring Break family volume.

audit.baggage_status: $45-$65+ Carry-on Fee (Frontier personal item only included)
gotchas: 100.0th percentile historical pricing indicates severely inflated Spring Break rates
Frontier unbundled base fare means adding standard carry-on and seat selection will significantly increase the true cost
Airbus A320neo high-density seating configuration with minimal recline
positive_highlights: Convenient 1h 43m nonstop direct routing on the ATL-MCO corridor
Favorable morning departure time of 10:05 AM avoids dawn-patrol wake-ups
audit.rationale: At the 100th percentile of historical pricing, this Spring Break fare is heavily price-gouged despite the nonstop convenience. Budget carrier ancillary fees for bags will quickly push this $258 ticket past the cost of legacy carriers, making it wise to wait for a price correction or compare with Southwest.

audit.baggage_status: Free Overhead Roller Included for Standard Economy
gotchas: Extremely overpriced at the 97.8th percentile for this corridor
Absurd 1-stop routing via EWR (Newark) for a CLT-MIA flight, tripling travel time
Tight 30-minute connection at EWR risks missed flights and baggage separation
Airbus A319 operating regional-style legs for a simple Southeast flight
positive_highlights: Standard economy ticket includes full size carry-on baggage
audit.rationale: At the 97.8th percentile, paying $518 for a convoluted one-stop routing via Newark to get from Charlotte to Miami is a terrible value. Wait for nonstop American Airlines or low-cost alternatives to drop significantly below this peak price.
